MEDELLÍN, Colombia, Nov. 25, 2026
-- Mineros S.A. (TSX: MSA; BVC: MINEROS; OTCQX: MNSAF) (“
Mineros
” or the “
Company

”) announces that today its subsidiaries, as borrowers, entered into two senior secured lines of credit for an aggregate amount of US$250 million: (i) a US$150 million syndicated credit facility entered into by Mineros Switzerland AG with a group of financial institutions led by Banco BTG Pactual S.A. – Cayman Branch, as arranger, and TMF Group New York LLC, as administrative agent (international tranche); and (ii) a US$100 million credit facility entered into by Hemco Mineros Nicaragua S.A. with Banco de América Central, S.A. (Nicaraguan tranche).
The two facilities form part of a structure with complementary purposes:
International tranche:

supports the Company’s growth portfolio. Amounts drawn can be used for general corporate purposes, including capital investments, and will support the next development phase of Porvenir in Nicaragua and the advancement of La Pepa (Chile).
Nicaraguan tranche:
recovers the investments in fixed assets made by Hemco between 2022 and 2025 with its own funds. It converts the capital already invested in the operation into available liquidity for Mineros.

Both facilities have a five-year term and amounts drawn will bear interest at Term SOFR plus 4.975% per annum. Principal will be repaid in eight installments beginning in month 18 after the closing date. The facilities are backed by corporate guarantees and security interests granted by Mineros companies.

The agreements include events of default customary for this type of transaction, including non-payment, breach of financial covenants, cross-default, insolvency and change of control, which could result in the acceleration of the obligations. There are no recourse mechanisms against third parties.

This transaction strengthens Mineros’ liquidity and financial flexibility by providing access to committed funds that it may draw, in whole or in part, as needed during the first year, with no obligation to use them immediately, and with an 18-month grace period on principal.

“The execution of these credit facilities demonstrates Mineros’ ability to access funding sources that support our growth strategy. Having committed funding available provides us with greater financial flexibility to advance our projects and address our investment priorities in a timely and disciplined manner, while retaining the flexibility to draw on these funds according to our business needs,”
said Natalia Correa, Chief Financial Officer (CFO) of Mineros S.A.
Lastly, Mineros' ratings remain at B1 (Moody's Ratings) and B+ with a stable outlook (S&P Global Ratings), according to each agency's most recent review.
About Mineros S.A.

Mineros is a leading Latin American gold producer headquartered in Medellín, Colombia. The Company has a diversified portfolio of assets that includes operating mines in Colombia and Nicaragua, together with a pipeline of development and exploration projects in the region, including the Porvenir development asset in Nicaragua, the La Pepa Project in Chile and the Tolima Project in Colombia.

With more than 50 years of operating history, Mineros is distinguished by its commitment to safety, sustainability and disciplined capital allocation. Its common shares are listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (MSA) and the Colombian Stock Exchange (MINEROS), and trade on the OTCQX® Best Market under the symbol MNSAF.
